title: Tamil Nadu Side or Puducherry Side? Border Property Compared
description: Property just across the Pondicherry border can cost less but follows different rules. What changes between Kottakuppam and Puducherry proper.
h1: Tamil Nadu side or Puducherry side: how to compare border property
lead: Around Pondicherry, a few hundred metres can put a plot in a different administration. The price per sq ft is only part of the comparison.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: Land in Puducherry and land in Tamil Nadu districts around it follow different planning authorities, registration rules and, often, different rates for stamp duty and registration. Check which side the property is on before comparing.

bullets: Total cost including registration, not only the price
Approving authority and approval status (see [DTCP vs PPA](/guides/dtcp-vs-ppa-approval-pondicherry))
Distance to town, schools and the highway
Resale demand and who buys in that area

paras: Kottakuppam is popular with buyers who want to be close to Pondicherry on the Tamil Nadu side. See our [Kottakuppam guide](/real-estate-kottakuppam) for what we see there.
Tell us two or three options. We will compare them on cost, approval and documents.

blocks.p: We will compare them for you, free.
